say:1:1721210001:1.text: Well now, Captain Fernand! Or should I say Viscount Fernand. I'm almost embarrassed you had to come all this way in person!
say:1:1721210001:1.source_cn: 哎呀！这不是守备军的队长，费南子爵吗？劳烦您亲自出马，...

say:3:1721210002:1.text: No need for titles. I'm here on duty. Fernand is fine.
say:3:1721210002:1.source_cn: 客气了，工作期间不必在意头衔爵位，直接叫我费南即可。

say:4:1721210003:1.text: Of course, of course. Ever dutiful, ever modest. Exactly what I'd expect from Viscount Fernand—ah, pardon me—Captain Fernand!
say:4:1721210003:1.source_cn: 当然，当然！真是兢兢业业、尽职尽责、不慕名利啊，不愧是...

say:6:1721210005:1.text: And the one with you would be...

say:7:1721210006:1.text: Dura above, it's Magister Merlin himself. Her Majesty sent you in person? What an honor!
say:7:1721210006:1.source_cn: ——艾雅在上，竟然是大魔法师梅林阁下！王后竟然请您亲自...
say:7:1721210006:1.male: Dura above, it's Magister Merlin himself. Her Majesty sent you in person? What an honor!
say:7:1721210006:1.female: Dura above, it's Magister Merlin herself. Her Majesty sent you in person? What an honor!

say:8:1721210007:1.text: That only proves how seriously the queen is taking my neon carp. This fish may well be the very thing that saves His Majesty. Worth every coin of the fortune I paid for it!
say:8:1721210007:1.source_cn: 可见王后对我的霓光鲤是多么的重视！它正是拯救国王陛下的...

say:9:1721210008:1.text: Now then, before the fish is presented, allow me to say a few words about...
say:9:1721210008:1.source_cn: 那么，在正式取鱼之前，就由我葛朗台，为诸位详细介绍一下——

say:10:1721210009:1.text: Baron, Merlin and I don't have all day. We've got other things to deal with.
say:10:1721210009:1.source_cn: ——葛朗台男爵，我与梅林阁下都不是闲人。取完鱼后，我们...
say:10:1721210009:1.male: Baron, Merlin and I don't have all day. We've got other things to deal with.
say:10:1721210009:1.female: Baron, Merlin and I don't have all day. We've got other things to deal with.

say:11:1721210010:1.text: Ah... Captain Fernand, I'm afraid I don't quite follow...
say:11:1721210010:1.source_cn: 那个……费南队长，请问您的意思是……？

say:12:1721210011:1.text: Save the speech. Let's just get the fish.
say:12:1721210011:1.source_cn: 跳过那些环节，直接取鱼吧。

say:13:1721210012:1.text: Ah. Well. It seems Her Majesty is so eager to secure the neon carp for the king that ceremony must give way to urgency!
say:13:1721210012:1.source_cn: 呃……咳嗯，王后对陛下果然情真意切，已经等不及想要取得...

say:14:1721210013:1.text: In that case, we shall move straight to the final part of the event—
say:14:1721210013:1.source_cn: 既然这样，我们就跳过前面的环节，直接进入最终部分——

say:15:1721210014:1.text: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!
say:15:1721210014:1.source_cn: ——由王宫派出的特使——当然，也就是我们众望所归的大魔...
say:15:1721210014:1.male: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!
say:15:1721210014:1.female: The palace's own envoy, none other than the illustrious Magister Merlin, will personally retrieve the legendary miracle fish, the neon carp!

choice_prompt:16:1721210014.source_cn: ——由王宫派出的特使——当然，也就是我们众望所归的大魔法师，梅林阁下——亲自捞取传说中的神鱼，霓光鲤！

say:17:1721210015:1.text: Naturally! I reserved this whole stretch of river so it could remain in peak condition right up to the final moment.
say:17:1721210015:1.source_cn: 没错！为了让霓光鲤以最佳状态献到诸位手上，我特意包下了...

say:18:1721210016:1.text: And now, Magister Merlin, the honor is yours. Please catch the miracle fish and present it to Her Majesty!
say:18:1721210016:1.source_cn: 现在，就请梅林阁下亲自捞取神鱼，献给王后陛下！
